identity.name: Context-Aware Outreach SaaS
principles: Fusion: Swiss Precision x Botanical Growth
Emotion: Calm Control, not Aggressive Growth
Content: Data is the hero, but context is the story
Safety First: UI should physically prevent mistakes

heading.usage: All H1-H3 headings. Adds editorial authority and human touch.

body.usage: UI text, paragraphs, inputs. Optimized for legibility.

mono.usage: Logs, ID numbers, code snippets, technical data.

primary.name: Royal Blue
primary.usage: Primary actions (Send, Create), Active states, Links

secondary.name: Olive Green
secondary.usage: Safety indicators, 'Approved' states, Success messages, Secondary actions

destructive.name: Signal Red
destructive.usage: Spam risk, Do Not Contact, Delete

background.note: Light mode has a tiny tint of green (Mint Cream) to reduce sterility. Dark mode is deep Slate.

gradients.forbidden: No full-screen gradients. No dark gradients.
gradients.allowed: Subtle 'glow' effects in dark mode only (e.g., behind active cards).

spacing.base: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 or Gap-8 for grids.

rules: Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly in marketing views.
Use col-span-2 or col-span-full for hero metrics.

cards.light: bg-white border border-border shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200
cards.dark: bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-none hover:bg-accent/5 transition-all duration-200

inputs.style: bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlay on the sidebar or dashboard background to reduce 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Layered shadows. shadow-sm for cards, shadow-xl for modals.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px borders are mandatory for separation. Do not rely on shadow alone.

principles: Smooth transitions (0.2s ease-out) for state changes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for normal text. Use APCA where possible.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attribute.

dashboard_empty_state.usage: Empty states, 404 pages, 'All caught up' screens.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Consistent across app.

rules: Do not use .tsx extension, use .js or .jsx.
Always add data-testid to interactive elements.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns/modals.
universal_guidelines: Create depth with z-index and shadows.
No 'text-align: center' on the main App container.
